about_the_game:
Rhythm is Life and Law

Rhythm is everything on the island of Suri, and when its harmony is broken, the land dances to a darker pulse.

Play as Ajira, a young girl fast and fearless, on her quest to find a fruit that can save her mother from the illness that killed her father.

But what begins as a simple trek through a forest, becomes a journey to restore the rhythmic balance of the island, and with it, life itself.

In SURI: The Seventh Note, rhythm isn’t decoration, but the law of nature. Learn its patterns. Trust its timing. When you move with the beat, the island moves with you

Game Features

• Rhythm-Driven Action – Run, jump, and phase in sync with the soundtrack. The world reacts to your timing, and missing the beat means losing your flow.

• Cinematic Escape Sequences – Push your reflexes through handcrafted chases where gameplay and music fuse into one.

• Evolving Abilities – Unlock rhythm-infused powers that expand your movement and combat as you learn to master the beat.

• A World That Breathes Music – From quiet ruins to chaotic arenas, each level is composed like a song  with its own tempo, tone, and emotion.
